method: Direct grep/regex counts against the working tree before and after Phase 10 implementation. Every count below was independently re-verified against the current file tree during the Phase 10 regression pass (see phase10-commodity-architecture-2026-08-27.md Part AC/AH).

commodity_category_layer.description: 10 new category pages did not exist before Phase 10 (Finding A in the Phase 9 opportunity map).

from_products_html_browse_by_category_se.note: 1 link per category, new section on products.html

from_product_breadcrumbs.note: every one of the 84 English product pages now links to its own category page from the breadcrumb nav

from_other_category_pages_related_catego.note: each of the 10 category pages links to the other 9 (full mesh), 10 x 9 = 90

to_products_prod_card_grid.note: every one of the 84 products appears in exactly one category's product grid, 1:1 coverage

to_related_articles.after: variable per category, filtered to exclude UNPUBLISHED_BLOGS placeholders

to_logistics_pages.note: rice-exporter-india.html links to both Mundra and Nhava Sheva logistics pages; no other category has a dedicated logistics page yet

export_documentation_locale_gap.description: Finding C in the Phase 9 opportunity map: the .jft-document-path contextual block existed on 46 English product pages (plus 13 pre-existing blog/tool pages) but had never been localized.

en_root_total.breakdown: 46 product pages + 13 blog/tool pages, unchanged - these already existed before Phase 10

locale_product_pages_total_across_10_loc.breakdown: 46 products x 10 locales, all newly added by scripts/fix_export_documentation_locale_links.py

locale_blog_pages.note: deliberately out of scope - blog article locale copies were not touched, matching the English precedent where only product pages carry this specific component

regional_page_product_linking.description: Phase 9 originally reported this as a blanket gap; Phase 10 investigation (Part A) found africa-trade.html and uae-trade.html already had .prod-card showcases and asia-trade.html already had contextual prose links. Only europe-trade.html genuinely had zero.

europe-trade.html.selection_basis: Europe is each product's primary documented market in data/products.json's f field

mismatched_further_reading_links_correct.note: these already had a further-reading link; it pointed to the wrong article (e.g. non-Basmati rice pointing to the Basmati export guide). Link count unchanged, link target corrected.

deliberately_left_unchanged.reason: already had a different, genuinely relevant existing link; adding a second forced link was judged to reduce quality, not improve it
